name: IRO
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $345 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's leather jackets (around $2,000), blazers, tailored trousers ($500–600), knits, tees and boots, plus menswear, sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Paris, France in 2004 by Laurent Bitton; Arik Bitton.

ownership.owner: Fosun International (majority shareholder since 2016; the Bitton brothers kept about 40%)

quote.q: Not a wardrobe for the models in the magazine but for the everyday cool girls, those you can see in the streets, always moving.

opview: “Not a wardrobe for the models in the magazine but for the everyday cool girls, those you can see in the streets, always moving.” — IRO (house), About us, iroparis.com

facts_read.source: brand site; FashionNetwork 2016-06-20; Fibre2Fashion 2016-07-06; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: IRO women's ready-to-wear and shoes; men's, archive sale, accessories excluded

doors.note: site iroparis.com/us; 41 stores worldwide, 3 in the US (Madison Avenue, SoHo, Venice Beach), all own doors; no US outlets or concessions listed (department-store doors on the list are in France, Spain and Portugal); no per-store pages, source_url is the locator page

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 251 women's RTW styles, proportional by garment group read from the name; census from the SFCC women's RTW grid (Search-UpdateGrid cg

craft_evidence.owned: no — Paris studio (11th arrondissement) is design (/us/iro/iro-studio.html)
craft_evidence.mills: none; one leather dress cites an LWG-certified tannery
craft_evidence.madein: 80 of 80 sampled pages state a country (China 27, Portugal 18, Turkey 17, Bulgaria 11, Romania 3, India 2, Tunisia 2)
craft_evidence.heritage: founded 2005, Paris; artistic director Nicolas Rohaut (/us/iro/iro-studio.html)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every product page states the country of make, and the house is dated and placed — but no maker, workshop or process is named. Country-on-page: 2.
